LESSON: MIRACLES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3.2: Miracles of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Miracles of Prophets
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is a miracle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
3. appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

• Listen/read the idea.

• Model B for “appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
• Model 2: explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
• Model 3: appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. Practise: explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
3. Practise: appreciate the miracles of the selected prophets to build their reliance on Allah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Miracles of Prophets.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is a miracle?
2. Why did prophets perform miracles?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
